hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord stared, his gaze wavering, at the two figures before him.
hunks.sol: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord stared at the two figures before him, his gaze wavering.

hunks.baseline: That was how much weight and meaning their titles carried: Fire King and Bow Saint.
hunks.sol: That was how much weight their titles carried: Fire King and Bow Saint.

hunks.baseline: No—that wasn’t all. There was even greater pressure than that.
hunks.sol: No—the pressure was greater than that.

hunks.baseline: For an instant, three footsteps overlapped.
hunks.sol: For an instant, three footsteps sounded together.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang and the Bow Saint slowly closed in from either side. The Blood-Sword Demon Lord instinctively stepped back, then belatedly realized what he’d done and flushed.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang and the Bow Saint slowly closed in from either side. The Blood-Sword Demon Lord instinctively stepped back, then realized what he’d done and flushed.

hunks.baseline: “…You damn old bastard.”
hunks.sol: “…You damn old monster.”

hunks.baseline: “Sounds pretty good today. Go on, say some more.”
hunks.sol: “That sounds good today. Go on, say some more.”

hunks.baseline: “Has that young brat’s hearing gone bad already? I said keep running your mouth.”
hunks.sol: “Are your ears already failing you, you little brat? I said keep running your mouth.”

hunks.baseline: He was visibly wounded, but a fierce heat still burned in his voice and across his face.
hunks.sol: He was visibly wounded, but a fierce heat still burned in his voice and on his face.

hunks.baseline: It was an obvious taunt, but he knew from experience that Jeok Cheongang wasn’t just putting on a show.
hunks.sol: It was an obvious taunt, but he could feel that Jeok Cheongang wasn’t just putting on a show.

hunks.baseline: No matter how far he’d surpassed his former limits, it was hard to imagine him gaining the upper hand against both the Fire King and the Bow Saint at once.
hunks.sol: No matter how far he’d surpassed his former limits, it was hard to imagine gaining the upper hand against both the Fire King and the Bow Saint at once.

hunks.baseline: And then, at that very moment, a streak of light cut through the air. For all its dazzling brilliance, it was more than enough to deepen the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s unease.
hunks.sol: At that moment, a streak of light cut through the air. Despite its dazzling brilliance, it only deepened the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s unease.

hunks.baseline: But the woman’s face, visible above them, was flawless, and her gaze fixed on the enemy beyond the dust cloud shone cold and bright.
hunks.sol: But the woman’s face, visible above them, was flawless, and her eyes shone cold and bright as she watched her enemy beyond the dust cloud.

hunks.baseline: *Three jang straight ahead. Three chi to the left.*
hunks.sol: *Three jang ahead. Three chi to the left.*

hunks.baseline: So Gyo—no, the great martial artist known by the title Bow Saint—thrust herself forward and gripped her beloved weapon.
hunks.sol: So Gyo—no, the great martial artist known as the Bow Saint—shot forward and gripped her beloved weapon.

hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord felt the surging power beyond them before he could even see it. He whipped his sword through the air with all his strength.
hunks.sol: Before the Blood-Sword Demon Lord could even see past them, he felt a surge of power on the other side. He swept his sword through the air with all his strength.

hunks.baseline: But the destructive trail of that bloody flash held no sign of the enemies the Blood-Sword Demon Lord was looking for.
hunks.sol: But the destructive trail of that blood-red flash held no sign of the enemies the Blood-Sword Demon Lord was looking for.

hunks.baseline: Only two different whistles tore in from the blind spot he couldn’t see.
hunks.sol: Only two different whistles tore in from a blind spot.

hunks.baseline: They had written their own legends then, and carried those legends into the present. In the distant future, countless people who loved to tell a story would sing of their deeds and praise them.
hunks.sol: They had written their own legends then, and carried those legends into the present. In the distant future, countless storytellers would sing of their deeds and praise them.

hunks.baseline: And perhaps, here today, a new verse would be written in that legend.
hunks.sol: And perhaps, here today, a new verse would be written in their legend.

hunks.baseline: It was a nimble movement he believed he would never be able to repeat in his life.
hunks.sol: He moved with an agility he doubted he could ever summon again in his life.

hunks.baseline: She had separated her beloved weapon, which had been shaped like a bow, into two curved swords. She had already passed him by.
hunks.sol: She had split her bow-shaped weapon into two curved blades. She had already passed him by.

hunks.baseline: The two flashes she’d swung, secretive yet swift as lightning, had torn away part of his nape and the shoulder of his left arm.
hunks.sol: With two flashes of those blades, swung stealthily yet swiftly as lightning, she had torn away part of his nape and the shoulder of his left arm.

hunks.baseline: But the attack, which should have been enough to take his life outright, had done surprisingly little. Before the pain could fully register in his mind, the Blood-Sword Demon Lord felt an appalling heat rush at him from the side.
hunks.sol: But an attack that should have taken his life outright had done surprisingly little. Before the pain could fully register, the Blood-Sword Demon Lord felt an appalling heat rush at him from the side.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist had swept fiercely past his flank.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist swept fiercely past his flank.

hunks.baseline: The heat from that glancing blow had melted away a fistful of flesh.
hunks.sol: That glancing blow alone melted away a fistful of flesh.

hunks.baseline: And the unbearable pain had made the Blood-Sword Demon Lord suck in a breath and stop moving without realizing it.
hunks.sol: And the unbearable pain made the Blood-Sword Demon Lord suck in a breath and stop moving without realizing it.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, the Blood-Sword Demon Lord was cheering deep down at the fact that he’d survived.
hunks.sol: At that moment, the Blood-Sword Demon Lord was cheering deep down because he had survived.

hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord had something to fall back on. An injury like this was something he could endure.
hunks.sol: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord had something to fall back on. Injuries like these were bearable.

hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord suppressed the pain surging through him and slashed his sword down at Jeok Cheongang, who watched him with eyes wide open.
hunks.sol: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord suppressed the pain surging through him and brought his sword down at Jeok Cheongang, who watched him with eyes wide.

hunks.baseline: No—more precisely, he tried to slash down.
hunks.sol: No—more precisely, he tried to.

hunks.baseline: But before he could, someone moved with a desperate resolve equal to—or perhaps greater than—his own moments earlier.
hunks.sol: Before he could, someone moved with a desperate resolve equal to—or perhaps greater than—his own moments earlier.

hunks.baseline: A fierce, unexpected pain shot through him. The Blood-Sword Demon Lord staggered, then stared in disbelief at the dark blade that had pierced his ankle—and at the face of the man holding it.
hunks.sol: A fierce, unexpected pain shot through him. The Blood-Sword Demon Lord staggered, then stared in disbelief at the dark blade buried deep in his ankle—and at the face of the man holding it.

hunks.baseline: Everything turned blindingly white, then red.
hunks.sol: Everything turned white, then red.

hunks.baseline: The dreadful heat, unlike Jeok Cheongang’s cold voice, melted flesh and broke bones as it sank deep into his body. Paralyzed by the excruciating pain, the Blood-Sword Demon Lord could do nothing.
hunks.sol: Unlike Jeok Cheongang’s cold voice, the dreadful heat melted flesh and broke bones as it sank deep into his body. Trapped by the excruciating pain, the Blood-Sword Demon Lord could do nothing.

hunks.baseline: Except that an unexpected stroke of luck awaited him—something even he hadn’t foreseen.
hunks.sol: But an unexpected stroke of luck awaited him—one even he hadn’t foreseen.

hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord spat blood mixed with bits of his innards. A voice drifted faintly into his ear.
hunks.sol: As the Blood-Sword Demon Lord spat blood mixed with bits of his innards, a voice drifted faintly into his ear.

hunks.baseline: Was it an illusion?
hunks.sol: Was he hearing things?

hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord blinked weakly as he wondered. Then he realized the slope beneath his battered body was a hillside, and that the voice he’d just heard sounded uncannily familiar.
hunks.sol: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord blinked weakly. Then he realized he’d landed on a sloping hillside, and that the voice he’d just heard was clear and familiar.

hunks.baseline: Blood bubbled in his throat, and every time his body shook with laughter, tremendous jolts of pain shot through his broken limbs. He didn’t care in the least.
hunks.sol: Bloody phlegm bubbled in his throat, and every time his body shook with laughter, tremendous jolts of pain shot through his broken limbs. He didn’t care in the least.

hunks.baseline: A streak of light whistled through the air. The Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s eyes flew wide.
hunks.sol: A sharp whistle cut through the air. The Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s eyes flew wide.

hunks.baseline: He saw a young man beyond the Grand Mage’s shoulder, hauling himself up from where he had fallen. With a fiery gaze, the young man brought his spearhead down.
hunks.sol: Beyond the Grand Mage’s shoulder, he saw a young man hauling himself up from where he had fallen. His eyes blazing, the young man brought his spearhead down.

hunks.baseline: It was Jin Taekyung, squeezing out every last bit of strength he had left to unleash a strike with all his might.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung was squeezing out every last bit of strength he had left for a strike with all his might.

hunks.baseline: *You’ve got to be fucking kidding me…!*
hunks.sol: *That crazy bastard…!*

hunks.baseline: In the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s eyes, still wide with a moment’s shock, someone’s figure was slowly tipping over.
hunks.sol: In the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s eyes, still wide with shock, a figure slowly began to topple.

hunks.baseline: If he were his former self—or even just an ordinary flesh-and-blood human—those injuries would have killed him several times over.
hunks.sol: If he were his former self—or even just a flesh-and-blood human—those injuries would have killed him several times over.

hunks.baseline: But his body, strengthened to an extreme degree, had granted him a brief handful of moments. Those moments would change everyone’s fate.
hunks.sol: But his body, strengthened to an extreme degree, had granted him a few moments. Those moments would change everyone’s fate.

hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord spoke, his breathing visibly growing more labored. The Grand Mage nodded calmly.
hunks.sol: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord forced out the words, his breathing noticeably more labored. The Grand Mage nodded calmly.
